Pilot
videos.overview: Tori Vega gets the chance of a lifetime, after filling in for her sister's performing act, she is given the opportunity to attend the elite Hollywood Arts High School. However, fitting in proves difficult when she is targeted by Jade when she sees her with her boyfriend, which causes her to wonder if she truly belongs there.

videos.title: The Bird Scene
videos.overview: Tori finds out that everyone who attends Hollywood Arts must complete "The Bird Scene." So, she works hard on preparing the monologue for her drama class. Elsewhere, André and Robbie enroll in a ballet class to meet girls, but their plan backfires.

videos.title: Stage Fighting
videos.overview: Tori gets a chance to perform an act of stage fighting, but things look bad for her when she gets paired up with Jade. However, when the two perform their scene, she encounters a problem when she is accused of deliberately hurting Jade during a fight scene. Meanwhile, Trina struggles with Robbie's constant displays of affection after an on-stage kiss.

videos.title: The Birthweek Song
videos.overview: Trina's birthday is a big deal in her world and because of this, Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina. André suggests that she writes a song, so as a gift from the heart. She then decides to write an amazing pop song for Trina as a present. However, an ungrateful Trina decides to turn her birthday gift into cash by selling the song, because she thinks it isn't an actual gift since Tori didn't spend any money on it. Meanwhile, Robbie is asked by his grandmother to teach her about computers, and Cat decides to tag along. She regrets it, however, when Robbie's Grandmother shows a deep dislike of her.

videos.title: Jade Dumps Beck
videos.overview: Jade has second thoughts about breaking up with Beck, so she asks Tori to help her win Beck back. Also, Robbie warns Trina that she is going to get a bad review for her one-woman show.

videos.title: Tori the Zombie
videos.overview: Tori encounters some bad luck when she gets a bad makeup job, which leaves her looking like a zombie. Things go from bad to worse when Tori has to give her first lead performance looking like a zombie on opening night.

videos.title: Robarazzi
videos.overview: Robbie is running into problems with his video news blog because it is stale and not very popular. However, Tori tells him that he can make it more interesting by uploading videos of his classmates' lives. Unfortunately, Robbie gets into trouble with his classmates when he goes too far. Meanwhile, Cat gets addicted to online-shopping.

videos.title: Survival of the Hottest
videos.overview: A heat wave hits L.A. and Tori and the gang decide to go to Venice Beach to cool off. Beck volunteers to take everyone in his Airstream RV. Once there, Cat leaves to find a bathroom while the rest of the gang stay back to get their beach stuff ready. They try to leave but the vehicle door is blocked another RV, leaving them trapped in the unbearable heat. Meanwhile, Cat is hanging out with four boys, not knowing about the gang's horrible ordeal.

videos.title: Wi-Fi in the Sky
videos.overview: Tori and Trina are on a plane ride which is delayed, and keeps Tori from finishing a homework assignment for script writing class, so she agrees to work on the script through a video chat with the help of Beck, Andre, and Cat. Unfortunateley, all end up facing distractions during the assignment. Among these distractions, Andre has to deal with his crazed grandmother, Beck is distracted by the jealousy of Jade, Cat is distracted by the special effects on her computer, and Tori is distracted by a fight between Trina and a little boy who keeps kicking her back seat.

videos.title: Beck's Big Break
videos.overview: Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from his role in a film while Robbie starts to have nightmares about his best friend.

videos.title: The Great Ping Pong Scam
videos.overview: Tori can't figure out why Jade, Beck, André, Cat, and Robbie won't let her join the Hollywood Arts ping-pong team.

videos.title: Cat's New Boyfriend
videos.overview: Cat's new boyfriend happens to be Tori's old boyfriend, and she struggles to restrain her jealousy. Meanwhile Trina gets all her friends into using some illegally imported fish to get smoother feet.

videos.title: Freak the Freak Out
videos.overview: Cat and Jade get banned from a hip karaoke bar. Meanwhile, Tori nurses Trina after her wisdom teeth are removed.

videos.title: Rex Dies
videos.overview: A giant turbo fan for the school stage ends up putting Rex's "life" at risk.

videos.title: The Diddly-Bops
videos.overview: Tori and her friends are booked to perform at a little kid's birthday party. Also, André gets the chance of a lifetime when he meets a record producer who might sign him to a record label. But his chances of getting signed are in jeopardy when a video of him and the others performing at the birthday party is leaked on the internet.

videos.title: Wok Star
videos.overview: Jade writes her own play called "Well Wishes" and wants to perform it at the school, but the school won't let her because they said its too weird. So Tori decides to help Jade put on the play herself.

videos.title: The Wood
videos.overview: Tori, Andre, Beck and Jade are chosen to be the stars of a reality show being filmed at Hollywood Arts called "The Wood". But, the show makes some of the stars look bad. Meanwhile, Robbie and Trina are forced to work at the Glub Truck after hurting the owner.

videos.title: A Film by Dale Squires
videos.overview: Tori and her friends are excited to work on a film directed by popular director Dale Squires, who unfortunately makes the kids do all the work, while he takes the credit. Beck helps Robbie fix an old car that his uncle gave him, after it breaks down in a bad neighborhood.

videos.title: Sleepover at Sikowitz's
videos.overview: Tori and her friends are excited to work on a film directed by popular director Dale Squires, who unfortunately makes the kids do all the work, while he takes the credit. Beck helps Robbie fix an old car that his uncle gave him, after it breaks down in a bad neighborhood.

videos.title: Beggin' on Your Knees
videos.overview: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues or is this guy bad news?

videos.title: Beck Falls for Tori
videos.overview: Tori auditions for a role in a movie. But after exaggerating on her resume, she gets hired as a stunt double. When Tori finds out her stunt is falling off a building, she's not sure she can do it.

videos.title: Ice Cream for Ke$ha
videos.overview: The group attempts to get a private Ke$ha concert by finding all the letters to K-E-S-H-A under ice cream cartons. And they go through a lot of trouble to get that concert.

videos.title: Tori Gets Stuck
videos.overview: Tori offers to donate blood after Robbie is rushed to the hospital, despite the fact that the school play is only a few hours away. Meanwhile, Cat, Beck, Andre, and Jade go to Karaoke Dokie to reclaim their title.

videos.title: Prom Wrecker
videos.overview: Tori finds out there has never been a prom at Hollywood Arts, and decides she wants to organise one. Sadly the chosen date conflicts with the day Jade was going to do a performance, and Jade does everything she can to try and sabotage Tori's prom.

videos.title: Locked Up
videos.overview: Trina and her friends take a vacation in a country that turns out to be a ruthless dictatorship, that arrests them on trumped-up charges.

videos.title: Helen Back Again
videos.overview: When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

videos.title: Who Did It to Trina?
videos.overview: Tori directs a play with Trina as the star. But when a mishap occurs on opening night, serious doubts are raised over whether or not it was truly an accident.

videos.title: Tori Tortures Teacher
videos.overview: It is Sikowitz's 10 year anniversary teaching at Hollywood Arts, and Tori and the gang celebrate by taking him to a play. But things go awry when Sikowitz becomes depressed after watching the play and Tori feels guilty and tries to fix it. Meanwhile, Trina tries to impress a boy she likes by pretending to be a pizza delivery girl, and Beck and Jade are text-fighting.

videos.title: Jade Gets Crushed
videos.overview: Andre develops a crush on Jade after they work together on a song and Tori tries to help him get over it. Also, Robbie tries to help Tori prepare for the Tech Theatre exam she must take and pass in order to take an R&B singing class, and Cat becomes obsessed with Jupiter boots.

videos.title: Terror on Cupcake Street
videos.overview: Tori and her pals have only one night to get a float to the big parade for a chance to be on television. The effort to do so becomes more difficult when they get stuck in a dangerous part of Los Angeles while trying to transport their float to the parade.

videos.title: A Christmas Tori
videos.overview: It's holiday time at Hollywood Arts and the kids have to find the perfect Secret Santa gifts for each other because whoever gives the worst gift has to go door-to-door yodeling with Sikowitz.

videos.title: Blooptorious
videos.overview: Blooptorious shows bloopers and outtakes of seasons one and and two of the show.

videos.title: The Breakfast Bunch
videos.overview: After a lunch mishap, Tori, Andre, Robbie, Beck, Jade, and Cat are forced to spend Saturday in detention.

videos.title: The Gorilla Club
videos.overview: After being told to take more risks, Tori goes to a dangerous underground club called the Gorilla Club which includes doing potentially life-threatening activities. Meanwhile, Andre and Robbie are forced to dance like "M.C. Hammer" in front of Jade after losing to her in poker.

videos.title: The Worst Couple
videos.overview: Jade and Beck make discoveries about their relationship while helping Sinjin with his game show. Meanwhile, Tori awaits the release of a new phone.

videos.title: Andre's Horrible Girl
videos.overview: Tori notices some changes in her friend Andre, whose girlfriend seems to be overbearing and controlling. Meanwhile, Jade and Cat try to earn easy money dog-sitting in Beverly Hills.

videos.title: Car, Rain & Fire
videos.overview: Cat talks Tori and Jade into holding a vigil when her favorite actress dies; Trina directs a play.

videos.title: Tori & Jade's Play Date
videos.overview: Tori and Jade portray a married couple from the 1970s, a task that challenges their acting skills and their friendship, especially since Tori plays the husband. Meanwhile, Cat and Robbie embark on a business venture in which they tell people negative news in an upbeat manner.

videos.title: April Fools Blank
videos.overview: Tori can't figure out why nobody at Hollywood Arts High celebrates April Fool's Day - or maybe they do.

videos.title: Driving Tori Crazy
videos.overview: When a movie shoot causes a traffic jam, interfering with Tori's morning commute, she asks each of her friends for help taking her to school. Cat becomes obsessed with a new app called "Tap It" which provides coupons.

videos.title: How Trina Got In
videos.overview: Tall tales are told about Trina and how she gained admission to Hollywood Arts. Elsewhere, Tori and Robbie realize they can’t pay a restaurant bill.

videos.title: Tori Goes Platinum
videos.overview: Tori wins a contest to sing the opening number at a big music awards show, but the producer wants to totally change her look and behavior. Tori agrees, but finds that she doesn't like her new image.

videos.title: Crazy Ponnie
videos.overview: Tori befriends a new classmate named Ponnie, who keeps vanishing when others are around. As a result, Tori's old pals begin to doubt her sanity.

videos.title: The Blonde Squad
videos.overview: Wearing a blond wig from a movie shoot, Cat meets and falls for a boy named Evan Smith.  When she finds out he prefers blondes, she decides to continue the ruse.

videos.title: Wanko's Warehouse
videos.overview: The group's favorite store is holding a big sale, so to avoid long lines and get first crack at the goods, they decide to hide in the store overnight.

videos.title: The Hambone King
videos.overview: Robbie posts a video online spotlighting his rhythmic talent of hamboning, and then he must face off against a challenger who claims to be better than him.

videos.title: Opposite Date
videos.overview: Tori and Beck go on a date where they do things not typically done on dates

videos.title: Three Girls and a Moose
videos.overview: Tori, Cat, and Jade try to win the affections of Beck's friend, Moose.

videos.title: Cell Block
videos.overview: Sikowitz challenges the kids to go a week without using their phones, laptops, or other portable electronic devices. The kids quickly realize it’s not going to be as easy as they thought.

videos.title: Tori Fixes Beck and Jade
videos.overview: Beck wants to ask a girl out but is worried about Jade’s reaction, so Tori and Andre attempt to get Jade a date to even the playing field. Robbie works to remove a butterfly stuck in Cat’s ear.

videos.title: One Thousand Berry Balls
videos.overview: Andre gets Tori a job at a frozen yogurt stand; Cat is jealous when Robbie asks someone else to the luau.

videos.title: Robbie Sells Rex
videos.overview: A spoiled child sets his sights on owning Rex. Elsewhere, a masked individual is throwing flour at school.

videos.title: The Bad Roommate
videos.overview: André stays with Tori to work on a song, but they hit a dissonant chord as roommates. A compromising photo of Jade appears on the internet.

videos.title: Brain Squeezers
videos.overview: When Tori is selected to be the team captain for a new game show, she must choose three of her friends to compete with her.

videos.title: The Slap Fight
videos.overview: Tori and the gang are caught up in a competition to see who can get the most followers on The Slap.

videos.title: Star-Spangled Tori
videos.overview: Tori worries she will forget the lyrics when she is invited to sing the national anthem at a televised basketball game.

videos.title: Victori-Yes
videos.overview: The students are challenged by Sikowitz to say yes to everything for one week. Trina brags about her acting role in a Mexican show called "Divertisimo."

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 6 wins & 39 nominations total
